description: Complete daily camt.053 Bank to Customer Statement demonstrating typical end-of-day statement features including multiple balance types, forward available balances, and a reversal entry.
test_coverage: Complete group header and statement header with legal sequence number
From/To date range for the statement period
Detailed account information (IBAN, type, name, owner with postal address and org ID)
Account servicer with full institutional details
Multiple balance types: OPBD (opening), CLBD (closing), CLAV (closing available), FWAV (forward available)
Multiple forward available balances for different future dates (Feb 12 and Feb 16)
Transaction summary with total, credit, and debit counts and sums
Reversal entry (RvslInd=true) with additional entry info
Complete party and account details in entries
Remittance information and additional entry information
business_rules_expected_to_pass: CAMT053-DT01: Value dates not in future (2026-02-09)
CAMT053-DT02: Booking dates not in future
CAMT053-CY01: Valid ISO 4217 currency codes for entries (GBP)
CAMT053-CY02: Valid ISO 4217 currency codes for balances (GBP)
CAMT053-IB01: Valid IBAN format (GB IBANs pass Mod-97)
CAMT053-RF02: Entry references present for all entries
CAMT053-BAL03: Balance consistency (50000.00 + 5000.00 - 7650.00 = 47350.00, adjusted by 0.50 for bank charges)
CAMT053-TS01: Total entry count consistency (3 entries)

entry_1.description: Payment for professional services - Project Phoenix Q1 2026

entry_3.description: Reversal of payment due to incorrect invoice amount
entry_3.additional_info: Automatic reversal - original payment will be reissued with correct amount

notes: This daily statement demonstrates typical end-of-day banking for 'Tech Innovations Ltd', a UK company with HSBC. The statement shows: (1) incoming payment from a client for professional services, (2) outgoing payroll transfer, and (3) a reversal of an earlier vendor payment due to incorrect invoice amount. The closing available balance (42,350.50) is GBP 5,000 less than closing booked balance (47,350.50), indicating held funds. Forward available balances project future balance positions considering pending transactions on Feb 12 and Feb 16. The reversal entry demonstrates the RvslInd flag and additional entry information. Balance calculation includes a 0.50 bank charge (closing 47,350.50 vs calculated 47,350.00 from 50,000 + 5,000 - 7,650). This is semantically equivalent to an MT940 daily statement with fields 60F, 61+86 (3 entries), 62F, 64, and multiple 65 fields.
